message.content: Trade affected them in several ways. It brought them grain, gold, and cloth. They used it to pay soldiers, build tombs, and reward loyal officials. We see that it increased their taxes and gave them more tools. It made their power stronger when they controlled ports, but it could weaken them if outsiders bypassed them. He, the pharaoh, could use it to show his authority, yet his officials might misuse it, so he had to trust them. That is why we study them.
